notes.subject: kraikrai strong, ol wasman
notes.rationale: three imperatives summon the shepherds to ritual mourning before the blow falls.

notes.subject: to ol wasman (ol lidaman bilong ol lain)
notes.rationale: direct second-person-plural address to the leaders, sustained through the verse.

notes.subject: ותפוצותיכם
notes.rationale: Hebrew leaves the verb implicit ('your days are full for slaughter, and your dispersions…'); translations supply 'are accomplished', as here with 'i pinis'.

notes.subject: binget long graun
notes.rationale: התפלש = roll (in dust); KJV 'wallow in ashes' vs JPS 'in dust' — the root is 'roll', not ash-specific.

translation: Kraikrai strong, ol wasman, na singaut, na binget long graun, ol bikpela man bilong ol sipsip na meme, long wanem ol dei bilong yupela i fulap na i pinis long taim bilong kilim yupela, na ol taim bilong skalim yupela; na bai yupela i pundaun olsem wanpela kago ol i laikim tumas.

tokens.gloss: na ol taim bilong skalim yupela
